sketches.mechanism: Optional binding creates a new non-optional name only inside the branch where the optional actually contains a value.
sketches.resonance: Absence cannot be addressed; presence is the condition for having a name at all.

sketches.mechanism: A linked process propagates an abnormal exit to the process linked to it unless that exit is explicitly trapped.
sketches.resonance: What is truly linked does not merely witness a loss; it is taken by it.
sketches.draft:
-module(grief).
-export([start/0]).
start() ->
    spawn_link(fun() -> exit(absence) end),
    receive after infinity -> ok end.
